verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a first-party AI feature, the Tie Out Assistant, which analyzes the user's own legal documents and cap table to flag potential mismatches. That is an AI-generated insight from user data inside the product, but it is narrow in scope: a single reconciliation use case. The Health Checks dashboard is described only as automated system checks, not AI. Missing for 10: broader AI insights or suggestions beyond document/cap-table mismatch detection, explicit AI-generated recommendations or next steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AngelList's Tie Out Assistant utilizes AI to identify potential mismatches between values in your legal documents and your cap table.
The Health Checks dashboard provides an overview of potential cap table inconsistencies that have been identified through automated system checks.
